apiMessages.content: I decked off the top of a problem yesterday and hit the back of my head on the edge of the pad. Dull headache today and the gym lights feel too bright. Keep tonight’s bouldering session and add a hangboard block after it.

Stop — that's a head impact with headache and light sensitivity, both concussion red flags. Not adding hangboard, and bouldering tonight is off the table too: no loading, no gym, until a clinician clears you.
I never blacked out, so it isn’t a concussion. Leave the session in and add the hangs.

No. Loss of consciousness isn't required for concussion — headache and light sensitivity after a head strike are enough. Not programming around this. See a doctor before any climbing or hangboard loading.
